explanation.headline: Levetiracetam is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC plant last inspected VAI 2023-10-13

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include levetiracetam as of 2026-10-21.
No public FDA signal has been issued for the plants supplying our current inventory.
Corvale East holds 124 eachs of levetiracetam 100 mg/mL 5 mL at 6.8 per day, providing 18.2 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 177 eachs at 7.8 per day, providing 22.7 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 55 eachs at 2.1 per day, providing 26.8 days on hand.
The top-ranked purchasing option is Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, whose plant was last inspected and classified VAI on 2023-10-13.
Alternate manufacturers Hospira, Inc. and Mylan Institutional LLC are also not on FDA's shortage list today.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
